results.title: Hoi An lantern festival 2026: Dates & ultimate local guide
results.content:
Quick Answer: The Hoi An lantern festival 2026 falls on the fourteenth day of each lunar month, giving thirteen dates: 2 January, 1 February, 2 March, 1 April, 30 April, 30 May, 28 June, 27 July, 26 August, 24 September, 23 October, 22 November and 22 December 2026. It runs from roughly 6pm to 10pm, it is free, and there is no ticket. The Old Town closes to traffic, the electric street lighting is switched off at around 8pm, and floating lanterns go onto the Thu Bồn. ## Experience Hoi An’s Lantern Nights, Then Return To A Stay That Fits Your Pace

After an evening walking through Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets, returning somewhere quieter allows the experience to continue naturally. [...] | Event Detail | Information |

While the monthly Full Moon Lantern Festival follows the rhythm of the lunar calendar, the international festival creates a larger gathering around one of Hoi An’s most recognisable traditions. [...] For travellers visiting Hoi An in December 2026, there will be another lantern experience alongside the traditional monthly celebration.

The inaugural Hoi An International Lantern Festival 2026 is planned from December 3 to December 6, 2026, offering visitors another opportunity to experience lantern culture through performances, activities, and international participation.

## 3. What Unfolds on Festival Night (Timeline and Traditions)

When festival night arrives, Hoi An Ancient Town transforms into a walking only pedestrian sanctuary from 5:00 PM onward. Here is what happens from late afternoon until midnight: [...] Held on the 14th and 15th days of the 8th lunar month (September 24 to 25 in 2026, and September 14 to 15 in 2027). This is Vietnam biggest lantern extravaganza with lion dance championships, mooncake feasts, and thousands of festival goers. [...] Many visitors mistakenly believe the lantern festival occurs only once per year. In reality, there are two types of lantern festivals in Hoi An:

Monthly Full Moon Lantern Night

Takes place every month on the 14th day of the lunar month. Motorized traffic is prohibited in the Ancient Town, neon signs are replaced by traditional silk lanterns, and river sampan boats launch glowing paper lanterns onto the Hoai River.

Grand Mid Autumn Festival (Tet Trung Thu)
